<!--
Table S4 (fit metrics) and Figure S3 (model fit to calibration data).
Input: squaredrun.csv (results/ or the project folder) from Canada_projection_rsquared.cmd (5,000 posterior draws,
variables sim1-sim10 = model, data1-data10 = data; listed in savelist_rsquared_SOURCE_CA.lst).
Run from the project folder; writes "Table S4.csv" and "Figure S3.svg" to "figures and tables/".
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(svglite)

results_dir <- "results"
# The .cmd files write their CSVs to the project folder; use results/ if the file was moved there
find_result <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(results_dir, f))) file.path(results_dir, f) else f
figures_dir <- "figures and tables"
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r read}
data_raw <- fread(find_result("squaredrun.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
names(data_raw) <- str_squish(gsub("\\.", " ", names(data_raw)))
data_raw <- data_raw %>% select(matches("^T\\d+\\s+(sim|data)\\d+$"))

## 1) Long format: year + variable (sim#/data#) + value; T0 = 2009
df_long <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(sim_run = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sim_run, names_to = "temp_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(year     = 2009 + as.integer(str_extract(temp_col, "(?<=^T)\\d+")),
         variable = str_extract(temp_col, "(sim|data)\\d+$")) %>%
  select(sim_run, year, variable, value)

## 2) Mean across the 5,000 posterior draws
df_mean <- df_long %>%
  group_by(year, variable) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r pair}
## 3) Years with observed (non-interpolated) data for each series
allowed_years <- list(
  `1`  = c(2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2017,2019,2023),
  `2`  = c(2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2017,2019,2023),
  `3`  = c(2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2017,2019,2023),
  `4`  = c(2009,2011,2012,2014,2015,2017,2019,2023),
  `5`  = c(2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2017,2019,2023),
  `6`  = 2009:2023,
  `7`  = 2016:2023,
  `8`  = 2011:2023,
  `9`  = 2011:2023,
  `10` = 2009:2025
)

var_names <- tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~name,                                                                          ~y_max,
  1,  "Rx opioid use not as prescribed, no past year heroin/illegal synthetics use",  2000000,
  2,  "Rx OUD, no past year heroin/illegal synthetic use",                          600000,
  3,  "Rx OUD with past year heroin/illegal synthetics use",                         200000,
  4,  "Past year heroin/illegal synthetics use without OUD",                         800000,
  5,  "Heroin/illegal synthetics OUD",                                               200000,
  6,  "Buprenorphine receipt",                                                       80000,
  7,  "Methadone receipt",                                                           60000,
  8,  "Rx overdose deaths",                                                          2000,
  9,  "Heroin/illegal synthetics overdose deaths",                                   15000,
  10, "Total overdose deaths",                                                       15000
)

## 4) Pair model and data by series id, keep years with observed data
sim_mean  <- df_mean %>% filter(str_detect(variable, "^sim"))  %>%
  transmute(year, id = as.integer(str_remove(variable, "^sim")),  sim  = mean_value)
data_mean <- df_mean %>% filter(str_detect(variable, "^data")) %>%
  transmute(year, id = as.integer(str_remove(variable, "^data")), data = mean_value)

paired <- sim_mean %>%
  inner_join(data_mean, by = c("year", "id")) %>%
  filter(mapply(function(y, i) y %in% allowed_years[[as.character(i)]], year, id)) %>%
  arrange(id, year) %>%
  left_join(var_names, by = "id")

paired %>% group_by(id, name) %>%
  summarize(n_years = n(), years_used = paste(year, collapse = ","), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r metrics}
r2_cor <- function(a, f) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(f)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  cor(a[ok], f[ok])^2
}
me  <- function(a, f) mean(f - a, na.rm = TRUE)          # signed mean error (model - data)
mae <- function(a, f) mean(abs(f - a), na.rm = TRUE)
theil_u2 <- function(a, f) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(f); a <- a[ok]; f <- f[ok]
  if (length(a) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  a_lag <- dplyr::lag(a); ok2 <- !is.na(a_lag)
  rmse_model <- sqrt(mean((f[ok2] - a[ok2])^2))
  rmse_naive <- sqrt(mean((a[ok2] - a_lag[ok2])^2))
  if (is.na(rmse_naive) || rmse_naive < 1e-9) return(NA_real_)
  rmse_model / rmse_naive
}
smape_pct <- function(a, f, tol = 1e-9) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(f) & (abs(a) + abs(f)) > tol
  if (sum(ok) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(2 * abs(f[ok] - a[ok]) / (abs(a[ok]) + abs(f[ok]))) * 100
}

metrics_by_series <- paired %>%
  group_by(id, name) %>%
  summarize(n_data_years = sum(!is.na(data)),
            R2        = r2_cor(data, sim),
            ME        = me(data, sim),
            MAE       = mae(data, sim),
            SMAPE_pct = smape_pct(data, sim),
            Theil_U2  = theil_u2(data, sim),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(id)

overall_row <- metrics_by_series %>%
  summarize(name = "Average across series", n_data_years = NA_integer_,
            R2 = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE), ME = NA_real_, MAE = NA_real_,
            SMAPE_pct = mean(SMAPE_pct, na.rm = TRUE), Theil_U2 = NA_real_)

table_S4 <- bind_rows(metrics_by_series, overall_row) %>%
  select(`Time series` = name, `Data years` = n_data_years, R2, `Mean Error` = ME,
         `Mean Absolute Error` = MAE, `SMAPE (%)` = SMAPE_pct, `Theil's U2` = Theil_U2) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

knitr::kable(table_S4, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
fwrite(table_S4, file.path(figures_dir, "Table S4.csv"))
```

```{r figure-S3, fig.align="center", echo = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 10}
## plot only years that have data (e.g. NDHU after 2019 is not a model data point)
paired <- paired %>% filter(!is.na(data)) %>% mutate(name = factor(name, levels = var_names$name))
## y-axis range per panel: 0 to y_max, except methadone (narrow range so the fit is visible)
y_min  <- ifelse(var_names$id == 7, 40000, 0)
y_lim  <- bind_rows(var_names %>% mutate(y = y_min), var_names %>% mutate(y = y_max)) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = var_names$name))

p_fit <- ggplot(paired, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_blank(data = y_lim, aes(x = 2009, y = y)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim, colour = "Simulation"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = data, colour = "Observed data"), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 40)) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Simulation" = "#1F78B4", "Observed data" = "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2009:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid  = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11))

print(p_fit)
```

```{r save}
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "Figure S3.svg"), p_fit, width = 8, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
